The jade register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and ocean seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 487 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
